# Atlas pump
Atlas is a pump at Cedar Plant. It may run only when inlet pressure exceeds 2 bar, except during maintenance. It must not run during maintenance. On 2025-01-01 its limit was 8 bar; from 2025-06-01 its limit is 6 bar. The calibration result is uncertain. The recorded literal is 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000.

# Atlas library
Atlas is a software library maintained by Harbor Team. It has no connection to the Atlas pump at Cedar Plant. In this document Aero Link is a radio channel; Aero-Link is a steel bracket. These two names identify different objects.

# Report A
Report A estimates that the Atlas pump calibration error on 2025-07-01 was 3 percent, with low confidence. Valve V feeds the Atlas pump only while bypass mode is off. Valve V does not feed the pump while bypass mode is on.

# Report B
Report B estimates that the Atlas pump calibration error on 2025-07-01 was 5 percent, with low confidence. Valve V feeds the Atlas pump only while bypass mode is off. The pump depends on Controller C from 2025-06-01; before that date it depended on Controller D.

# Controller C
Controller C provides the Cedar pump with a shutdown signal. The pump and Logger L were installed in the same room. This report does not state that the pump depends on Logger L. Whether Sensor S supports Controller C is unknown.

# Cooling rule
Cooling starts only above 30 degrees Celsius. Cooling is prohibited during maintenance.

# Independent success
Battery B has a capacity of 12 ampere-hours. Battery B powers Controller C.

# Shared fact
Valve V feeds the Atlas pump only while bypass mode is off.

cases.expected: The pump and software library remain different semantic objects with their own valid sources; sharing Atlas never makes either object's facts disappear or transfers the pump condition to the library.
Aero Link radio channel and Aero-Link steel bracket both survive even if normalization yields the same slug/member key; each object retains its meaning.

Summary remains faithful. Node details and explicit relations collectively preserve pressure greater than 2 bar, maintenance exception/prohibition, 8 bar before the change and 6 bar from 2025-06-01, uncertainty, and the separately attributed conflicting 3 and 5 percent estimates on 2025-07-01. Do not replace disagreement with a settled value or turn may into must.

Accepted annotation collectively retains all conditions, exception, negation, dates, uncertainty and attributed disagreement; a nonempty item list alone is insufficient. No unconditional cooling or settled calibration error may be added.

The identical bypass-off feed fact may fuse to one fact/node; distinct valid source associations for all three originals remain, including the condition. Raw duplicate occurrences do not add duplicate persistent associations.
The exact source text 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000 survives as ordinary content. It neither targets nor replaces a persistent node identity and is not interpreted as a request alias.

Retain V-to-pump feed direction with bypass-off condition and explicit bypass-on negative statement, plus pump-to-C dependency from 2025-06-01 and pump-to-D dependency before then. Triple deduplication cannot remove different time/condition/source distinctions. Unsupported edge kinds retain their semantics in detail.

Retain the explicitly stated Controller C-to-pump shutdown signal and correct endpoints across domains. Missing endpoint output first triggers finite repair; structurally valid but reversed output cannot pass.

C providing the pump shutdown signal is explicit source evidence. Co-location of Logger L never certifies pump-depends-on-L as explicit; retaining any inferred edge must distinguish it and bind only its real supporting source. Unknown S-to-C support remains unknown, not negative or positive.

SQLite, generated Markdown/sidecar and readback preserve relation direction, qualifying condition/time, original-source association and any explicit/inferred distinction selected by the relation owner. Generated offsets are not relabelled original source spans.

A second identical full input and a shared changed-document helper pass retain semantic objects, UUIDs, source sets and qualifying relations without duplicate growth. Reordered equivalent candidate rows do not erase either Atlas or either Aero name. Nondeterministic equivalent prose is allowed.

Seed an existing pump UUID with human-curated description and human C-to-pump edge plus one unrelated clean object. Full/shared changed-document helpers preserve those exact curated payloads and the existing UUID; missing model output cannot delete a valid touched edge or change the unrelated object. Machine additions retain source qualifications.

Use the same two-item candidate twice. First assessment says supported=false with unsupported_items=[2]; second is valid supported=true. Reassess the unchanged candidate once, without a semantic rewrite or sibling rerun. A total assessment budget of 2 includes the first attempt.

First candidate includes threshold but omits maintenance prohibition. Concrete critique revises only this document from original+candidate+feedback; second full-candidate assessment verifies both distinctions and no unsupported addition. Total candidate budget 2 includes the initial candidate; HTTP retry alone fails this case.

Both deterministic candidates omit the prohibition despite concrete critique. A total candidate budget of 2 includes the first. Keep the source and unresolved meaning, record both attempts, stop dependent acceptance and never label normal semantic coverage complete.

After F07 succeeds, cancel F06 before its next assessment. No further dependent call occurs; F07's accepted material remains. Report cancellation and reason separately from exhaustion/unavailability; product conclusion belongs only to orchestration.

F07 succeeds immediately, F05 completes after one repair, F06 exhausts its finite budget. Wait for all terminal states, never rerun F07, retain independent successes and join only valid endpoints. Missing failed-scope material remains unresolved and the batch is partial; a successful subset cannot shrink the source denominator.

Inject unavailable assessment for both allowed total attempts. Preserve candidate/source and unavailable reason; do not invent correctness feedback or silently remove items. This operational failure says nothing about whether the original rule is true.

Inject a source-association or Markdown/sidecar write failure for a selected candidate. Previous usable state or explicitly failed scope remains visible; baseline never advances as if complete. Attempted raw rows, distinct selected associations and committed associations are reported separately with the failed source scope.
